select warehouse_id,warehouse_name,sku_id,sku_no,source_type,source_code,transport_qty from ( select max(warehouse_id) as warehouse_id,max(warehouse_name) as warehouse_name ,max(sku_id) as sku_id,max(sku_no) as sku_no, max(source_type) as source_type,max(source_code) as source_code,sum(qty) as transport_qty,max(trade_time) as trade_time, max(bill_date) as bill_date from ( select tf.warehouse_id,tf.warehouse_name,tf.trade_time,tf.bill_date,tf.sku_id,tf.sku_no,tf.qty, case when tf.source_type in('instockForcast','warehouseReceive','purchaseStockIn','purchaseReturnOrder') then 'purchase' when tf.source_type in('transferOut','transferIn') then 'transfer' else '' end as source_type, case when tf.source_type = 'instockForcast' then inv.purchase_order_code when tf.source_type = 'warehouseReceive' then wr.purchase_order_code when tf.source_type = 'purchaseStockIn' then po.purchase_order_code when tf.source_type = 'purchaseReturnOrder' then pr.purchase_order_code when tf.source_type = 'transferOut' then tfo.code when tf.source_type = 'transferIn' then tfi.source_code else '' end as source_code from transaction_flow tf left join instock_forcast inv on inv.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'instockForcast' left join po_receive wr on wr.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'warehouseReceive' left join po_instock po on po.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'purchaseStockIn' left join po_return pr on pr.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'purchaseReturnOrder' left join transfer_out tfo on tfo.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'transferOut' left join transfer_in tfi on tfi.id = tf.source_id and tf.source_type = 'transferIn' where 1 = 1 and tf.is_deleted='f' and tf.dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' and tf.source_type in ('instockForcast','warehouseReceive','purchaseStockIn','purchaseReturnOrder','transferOut','transferIn') and tf.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId} and tf.sku_id = #{params.skuId} ) m
and m.source_type = #{params.sourceType}
and m.source_code ilike concat('%', #{params.sourceCode}::text ,'%')
group by source_type,source_code order by bill_date desc ) t where t.transport_qty > 0

and (#{params.date}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > tf.trade_time
and (#{params.date}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > tf.bill_date
